symptoms: MIL illuminated in applicable bulletin cases

cause_candidates.condition: Outdated ECM calibration relative to exact VIN/ECU
cause_candidates.evidence: OEM USA TSBs S01/S02/S03 prescribe calibration checking; not a proof of defective ECM

cause_candidates.condition: Other engine-off timing/ECM or power issues
cause_candidates.evidence: If latest calibration, bulletin ceases to apply and model Repair Manual diagnosis required

diagnostic_steps: Record DTC and freeze-frame via Techstream; verify ECU and VIN.
Check ECM calibration ID and any Authorized Modifications Label against the matching Lexus bulletin for that exact vehicle.
Only if calibration is outdated and all bulletin prerequisites match, carry out authorized ECM calibration update with controlled supply following OEM reflash procedure.
If calibration is current or DTC returns after update, diagnose using the vehicle-specific Repair Manual; never replace ECM solely from this code.

live_data.test_condition: Techstream ECM information, compare per exact ECU and bulletin

tools: Approved battery support for OEM reprogramming

records.translation_ar: كفاءة نظام المحفّز أقل من الحد المحدد — جهة الأسطوانات الثانية (Bank 2)

cause_candidates.condition: O2 sensor Bank 2 Sensor 2 signal/impedance condition within TSB
Other catalyst, sensor, exhaust or mixture issues
cause_candidates.evidence: OEM bulletin requires return to normal Repair Manual diagnostics if criteria not met; alternatives not ranked

diagnostic_steps: Verify the displayed P0430 using Techstream and match 2010 RX450h 2GR-FXE US vehicle scope.
With engine at normal operating temperature, check O2 B2S2 voltage and O2 B2S2 impedance under the OEM bulletin procedure.
For this bulletin ONLY: if voltage equals 1.275 V OR impedance is above 300 ohms, follow bulletin for Bank 2 downstream O2 sensor and harness clamp; no generalization to other models.
If neither threshold is reached, bulletin does not apply. Follow VIN-matched diagnostic manual rather than replacing sensor/catalyst automatically.
Clear DTC and verify after repair under bulletin conditions.

symptoms: Harsh engagement when shifting into Drive (may occur without DTC)

cause_candidates.condition: Outdated ECM main/sub calibration matching bulletin and VIN

cause_candidates.evidence: If current calibration, continue VIN-matched Repair Manual; no assumed solenoid defect

diagnostic_steps: Confirm P07457F and/or harsh engagement when shifting into D on RX350 MY2019 with 8AT.
Check Techstream ECM main/sub calibration IDs and Authorized Modifications Label against correct production plant, trim, drivetrain, and VIN threshold in Rev1 bulletin.
If calibration already latest, stop applying TSB and continue vehicle-specific transmission diagnostic tree.
If out of date and eligible, reprogram ECM per L-SB-0001-18 using GR8 Power Supply Mode holding 13.5 V and qualified service workflow; do not replace ECM.
Perform specified post-flash 12V reset and road test; if fault remains, follow Repair Manual.
